note: Tennessee State Parks, Eva, on Kentucky Lake. Happy Hollow: tent and RV sites with water and electric hookups, table and grill, in a wooded hollow about 1 km from the lake, near a playground; central bathhouse. Closed for structural renovations; the dump station is out of use until they are done. --Claude

STATUS kept temporarily_closed, reopens 'early 2027' (unchanged). Since 2026-09 Lake Front Campground has reopened; Happy Hollow has not.

NOT A LEAD: Lake Front Campground (Nathan Bedford Forrest SP, on Kentucky Lake near Pilot Knob; not in the DB) is open with 14 bookable sites, 30/50A + water, $32-38, but posted RV lengths are 10-20 ft (sites 1-12 gravel drive-up 10-20 ft, 13-14 concrete back-in 18 ft) - under the ~23-ft minimum.
WATERFRONT 'not waterfront' confirmed: Happy Hollow is in an inland wooded hollow ~1 km from the lake.
Hookups: page says 'water and electrical hookups' with no amperage - electric not written.
PHONE 888-867-2757 is Central Reservations (the page lists no park-office number). PIN fine. Website kept.
Site count: the May 2026 capture says 'Two standard campgrounds ... with 50 standard sites between them' (Lake Front has 14, so Happy Hollow ~36); not written.
